title: Hanasato Minori — Painful Honesty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'd like for us to start discussing talk segment ideas for the shoot the day after tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you sure about none of you being tired? You already spent a lot of time today house hunting and had that meeting at the TV station to boot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO, but we've still got plenty of energy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may be substitutes for another group, but this is still a very big opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. And we want to send in our idea today since there isn't much time left until the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, you said that you're supposed to come up with your own segment. Does anyone have ideas for it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I've got one!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Already? That's impressive, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what's your idea?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
My idea is...!
A quiz about weird floor plans!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A quiz about weird floor plans?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: While we were moving between those different houses today, Ms. Kawanishi told us about some other properties!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: There's actually an interesting property right near here.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: It's very spacious and includes three rooms, but they're all meant for bathing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean they're all bathrooms?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! One with a jacuzzi, another with a hot stone bath and the last one included a steam room!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, if they're all bathrooms, is there nowhere to sleep?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Apparently, the original owner loved bathing so much that they decided to design multiple rooms just for that purpose.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were told that a heated waterfall was also in the works.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A heated waterfall?
As in a regular waterfall but with hot water?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but it ended up being too hard to build a room for it from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The owner was so set on having a waterfall that they ended up moving out. As a result, this house is now available for rent.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They moved out? Having a heated waterfall was that important...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope their new home has what they want.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too♪
Wait, hang on. You said something about a quiz.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, the question for this house would go something like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The original owner of this house loved to do a certain thing so much that they decided to build three rooms with said activity in mind! What are these rooms for?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. The basement bedroom for this other house we heard about was called the “vampire room”. There were a lot I could turn into fun quiz questions!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, this is turning into an interesting quiz!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. This could work, provided we can explain why we're doing a quiz on this topic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why? Because it's fun and interesting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Those are both important, but this quiz seems a bit out of place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, who should present a quiz based on funny responses to gags? An idol or a comedian?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... A comedian, right...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. It would be odd for an idol to suddenly start talking about real estate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we can't just tell everyone the truth by saying that these are all houses we heard about from an actual realtor while searching for our own...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
But I thought I'd come up with such a fun quiz.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, it's way too soon to give up on that idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're being asked to appear on short notice this time, so we could sort of blur things by saying that we saw some interesting rentals while walking by our local real estate agency.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's still not something idols would talk about normally, but we could try saying, “Has this ever happened to you?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that might actually work...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Now all we have to do is ask Ms. Kawanishi if we can talk about these, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can also ask to see if we can get the actual floor plans for these properties.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But will we receive them in time?
Our shoot's in just two days...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. The producer also has to sign off on it, so we might want to come up with a backup plan just in case.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we already have a viable option thanks to Minori, so we should have no problem replying today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're giving me too much credit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we're not about to let you hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.
